title: First meeting Lester Young in Kansas City
summary: He knew Lester from Kansas City, where he lived and married in 1932, but cannot recall their first meeting.

blocks.x: Was -- had you met Lester before you --
Do you remember when you first ran into him?
Not really. He used to come to Kansas City. I used to live in Kansas City you know. In fact I got married in Kansas City when I was out there in 1932. Kansas City, Kansas. (Inaudible).
Well I guess you wouldn't remember really heard him play the first time and if he --
